title: Sagittarius, babe: 2 blocks counts.
caption: Sagittarius will book four flights before the coffee gets cold. Your star guide has a smaller idea: a new café two blocks away still counts as an adventure, as long as you go together. Send this to the Sagittarius who calls every errand a trip.
